tile.scaleRule: nearest-neighbour-required; integer scale preferred; do not alter viewport or layout

runtimeRequestContract.adjacencyRule: set a direction bit iff the in-bounds N/E/S/W neighbor GroundType raw value exactly equals the center ground raw value; out-of-bounds and different grounds leave the bit clear

terrainVariation.featureVariant: stable 0...3 selected from terrainSeedUInt32; each ground owns four named feature templates
terrainVariation.worldGrade: world-derived signed RGB/value offsets; stable for a world; semantics remain readable in grayscale
terrainVariation.ownership: world data selects grade; tile seed selects bounded feature template; redraw never rerolls

flora.tileResolution: Tile.flora nil means no flora; otherwise resolve exact InstanceID in WorldRun.flora

identity.uint64Transport: decimal string or native UInt64; never JSON double

traits.units: Swift Double pressure scale 0...100; clamp then round to nearest integer
traits.woody: tissue.woody; then normalize woody/fibrous/fleshy to integer sum 100 with last-component remainder
traits.cyan: coloration.cyan; normalize CMY to integer sum 100 with last-component remainder

flora.legacy: Swift tolerant decoder owns defaults before adapter: nil Tile.flora => none; missing Flora.traits => FloraTraits(); missing worldSeed => 0; missing nested fields use their Swift model defaults. Adapter rejects missing post-decode traits or unknown enums and never substitutes AssetLab floraDefaults.

liveInputContract.nativeAdapterObligation: supply an already-derived terrainSeedUInt32 from persisted mapSeed + tile coordinate + immutable pipelineVersions; derivation is native-owned and must be frozen/tested before integration; never use proofFixtureSeed

seedContract.runtimeInput: prederived terrainSeedUInt32 is mandatory; this contract deliberately does not claim a cross-platform derivation algorithm
seedContract.floraIdentity: resolve Tile.flora through WorldRun.flora; never redraw RNG
seedContract.integerDomain: UInt64 live identity; explicit stable uint32 derivation at adapter boundary

nativeConsumption.strategy: native renderer/cache validated against this conformance pack

fog.rule: if Tile.isRevealed is false, paint one invariant uniform fill and return before composing terrain/flora/crack/content/route/party; minimap is separately game-gated

minimap.defaultRule: every POI requires legitimate revealed/discovered knowledge
minimap.entrancePortalRule: visible only because its starting tile is revealed; no portal exception
minimap.investedKnowledgeRule: future bounded effects may pass game-owned discovery; AssetLab never infers it

uncovered: top-down party and character sprites; retain existing native party overlay in this slice
unsafeProofOnly: all exported PNGs are conformance fixtures, not an exhaustive runtime atlas
all exported flora descriptors in this pack (conformance examples, not live identity)
all labels, legends, checkerboards and grayscale transforms
JavaScript command arrays as a production runtime dependency

outputs.semantics: transparent conformance sentinel; compositor short-circuit paints invariant #17171a and suppresses every lower layer
